title: Bound strategy-list owner reads after actual hosted timeout

observed_failure.error: TimeoutError: The operation was aborted due to timeout
observed_failure.bff_log_correlation: At 2026-11-05T17:43:08Z the management-candidate-reads probe issued GET /bff/strategies?page_size=100 and aborted at 20,002ms before BFF completed the response; during the subsequent Playwright /strategies check starting around 17:43:48Z, BFF logged GET /bff/strategies HTTP/1.1 200 OK only at 2026-11-05T17:44:05.788Z (~17s latency).

deterministic_bottlenecks_identified.issue: Unbounded full-history ranking table scan and per-row freeze/thaw/SHA-256 recomputation
deterministic_bottlenecks_identified.detail: Candidate 2a2411124c77ddce6c6963d927d99654c7e5f6fe wired GET /bff/strategies to StrategiesService.get_latest_ranking_snapshot() -> RankingSnapshotReadPort.get_latest_ranking_snapshot(). Because RankingReadStore lacked get_latest_ranking_snapshot, RankingSnapshotReadPort fell back to records_table.list_all() (SELECT payload FROM "rankings"."rankings" ORDER BY updated_at ASC) across all 140 historical snapshot rows (each containing 544 persona items) and ran _decode_ranking_snapshot(payload) on every historical row (deep-freezing, deep-thawing, canonical JSON serializing, and SHA-256 digesting ~76,160 persona items per uncached read) before discarding 139 of the 140 rows.

deterministic_bottlenecks_identified.issue: Pre-filter, pre-pagination full-inventory detail fanout and DTO projection
deterministic_bottlenecks_identified.detail: bff_list_strategies enriched (get_strategy_spec_detail when current_spec_version_id was absent) and projected (project_strategy_dto) all N strategies in the tenant inventory before applying the state filter and before slicing to page_size.

deterministic_bottlenecks_identified.issue: O(N_strategies * M_ranking_items) repeated linear scan of ranking_snapshot.items
deterministic_bottlenecks_identified.detail: _project_strategy_ranking_metrics linearly scanned all 544 items in ranking_snapshot['items'] and rebuilt normalized strategy_ids lists for every strategy projected (555 * 544 = 301,920 item inspections) instead of indexing strategy_id -> matched_rows once per request.

forensic_root_cause.unknown_historical_factors_preserved: Exact host CPU scheduling jitter and concurrent post-switch container warm-up contention at 2026-11-05T17:43:06Z were not separately captured by an in-process profiler; they determined whether the ~17-20s unindexed full-history scan + full-population projection crossed the 20,000ms probe abort boundary on a given request.

bounded_remediation.services/rankings/store.py: Added RankingReadStore.get_latest_ranking_snapshot(surface='quarterly') so PostgresJsonOwnerStore-backed ranking stores execute a bounded SELECT payload ... WHERE jsonb_typeof(payload) = 'object' AND payload ->> 'record_type' = 'ranking_snapshot' [AND COALESCE(payload ->> 'surface', '') = surface] ORDER BY COALESCE(payload ->> 'created_at', '') DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT 1 query via _records_table._connect() with zero GET-path DDL (no ensure_schema) and decode only the single winning row, while list_all()-backed stores select the winning latest candidate by (created_at, idx) before decoding only that single snapshot.
bounded_remediation.services/control-plane/bff/ports/ranking: Updated RankingSnapshotReadPort.get_latest_ranking_snapshot to delegate to RankingReadStore.get_latest_ranking_snapshot(surface=surface) via normal port wiring and, for injected list_all()/list_ranking_snapshots stores without get_latest_ranking_snapshot, select the winning latest candidate by (created_at, idx) before decoding or converting only that single winning snapshot.
bounded_remediation.services/control-plane/bff/strategies/se: Kept StrategiesService.get_latest_ranking_snapshot on clean public read_surface / owner_reads.latest_ranking_snapshot wiring with zero closure reflection, zero private BFF SQL, and zero GET-path schema DDL.
bounded_remediation.services/control-plane/bff/strategies/ro: Added _build_ranking_strategy_index(ranking_snapshot) for O(M) one-pass indexing and O(1) per-strategy lookup in _project_strategy_ranking_metrics while preserving fresh/missing/ambiguous/unavailable and real 0.0 semantics, and updated default_page_slice to honor page_token and emit next_page_token.

Validated all summary entries up front (never silently dropping malformed records), applied persona_id and state filtering before pagination, computed exact total across the full matching population, sliced to page_size via ctx.page_slice, pre-built ranking_index once per request, and bounded get_strategy_spec_detail enrichment and DTO projection strictly to the sliced page.
